_doc: One home per fact. Each block is the canonical text for a fact the skills repeat; check_skill_lint.py fails any other Markdown file under plugins/runpod/skills that copies a run of `min_words` consecutive words from one of these sections. Elsewhere, state the rule in your own one-line summary and link to the home. A decision rule or safety warning that MCP-only agents need may keep that one-line summary inline in a SKILL.md. A block's `allow` list names files that may keep such an inline copy, each with its reason.

allow.reason: create-cluster go rule: an MCP-critical safety rule the lifecycle journey states inline with its cluster-specific fields (exception in the one-home rule)
